scope: Single USB-C 5 V electrical design; no procurement prices, no EDA mutations.
status: Schematic prototype baseline; listed validation items remain open.
compatibility_limit: Default: AON only, no audio/Hub enumeration. Rp1.5A: digital enumeration/control/USB loopback, analog off by default. Rp3A: full-feature target subject to measured budget and voltage. Not every USB-C host supports this.

existing.note: Existing SY8089AAAC, TPS7A20 and GM1205 pin/parameter audit; not generic similar-number devices.

blocks.note: PORT low=UFP; ADDR floating=GPIO. Internal Rd, do not parallel external 5.1k Rd. OUT1/2 open drain.
Open-drain RESET clamps EFUSE_EN; G01 adjustable threshold has ±2% accuracy, not fixed-rail ±0.5%.
470A active current limit + adjustable OVLO + AUXOFF/FLT. 474 is circuit breaker. ITIMER open=fastest response; do not add blanking capacitor.
P version active discharge. COUT effective 0.47–200uF, ESR<=100mOhm. No NR/SS or PG.

calculations.power_budget_note: 3.8W/8.36W envelopes at3.8V are upper allocation limits including IMON/ADC error, not uncorrected ADC thresholds. Rp1.5 analog off. Full budget~8.6W at4.25V under stated efficiency assumptions; low voltage requires shedding phantom/loads.

parallel_load_budget.caveat: Allocation targets, not guaranteed load maxima. Efficiencies are explicit engineering assumptions pending measurement.

relay_coils.status: TBD exact coil model, rated current, pickup voltage/temperature and supply path
relay_coils.illustrative_only: If 3–4 coils each consume5V*30mA, add0.45–0.60W plus driver/conversion losses; not an approved relay specification.
relay_coils.constraint: Never add relay coil load to V5P_AFE/V5N_AFE. Dedicated switched coil supply must be specified and budgeted.

open_items: Hardware test: startup EN glitches, CC orientation/downgrade, effective input capacitance and USB inrush.
Do not wire AON push-pull signals into unpowered ESP GPIO. FLT pull-up is on V3V3_D; expose MODE_HIGH using a gate-isolated MOS open-drain mirror or Ioff buffer.

XU power sequence topology is proposed in xmos-boot-plan.json (three TPS3897A monitors). CORE_ENABLE uses the existing 100k pulldown once. Physical implementation, dynamic rail windows and measured reset/clock timing remain blocking before hardware sign-off.
Final 3.3V ADC/DAC local switch part/pins and independent DIG/CLK/L/R sequencing not yet frozen.
GM4.5 rail has no precise ESS recommended tolerance; full voltage/noise/transient acceptance remains physical validation.
AFE120mA, ADC4.5 steady60mA and RAW capacity target+600/-250mA require load/thermal/loop validation.150mA ADC capacity is not simultaneous load allocation.
BLOCKING before phantom enable: injected phantom surge enters AFE protection diodes; TPS7A39 cannot absorb arbitrary energy. Rail absorption/clamping design remains mandatory.
BLOCKING before headphone power cycling: TPA input must remain below600mV during power-off. Output relay alone is insufficient; hardware input mute/isolation remains required.
Relay coils are not covered by the8.634W subtotal; exact coil/supply budget remains open and may reduce permitted simultaneous features.
All generic MOSFET/diode body/footprint mappings need exact selected library device inspection; no UUIDs invented.
Prototype default-current ports do not start audio. Supporting legacy configured500mA requires another low-power USB bootstrap design.
USB Hub power descriptors/nonremovable ports and Type-C high-current consumption semantics require explicit USB review; never falsely claim self-powered.
USB suspend must retain a real wake path; do not power off the entire Hub and claim resume works.
